{{Vanilla|Enchanting}}
{{About|the enchanting system|the list of enchantments|Enchantment}}
'''Enchanting''' in [[Matcha Flavoured]] is done by crafting. The {{MCW|Enchanting Table|enchanting table}} cannot be crafted and experience is not spent on random enchantments. Instead, the player crafts a [[Hell-Bound Book]] and combines it with other items to make a [[blessing]], an enchanted book with fixed enchantments, then applies it to equipment with an [[anvil]].

== Design ==
The developer's introduction video describes enchantments as crafted, with the most wanted enchantments the hardest to get:
<blockquote>Enchantments are no longer random or use XP to receive. Instead, you craft them, and the rarest, most difficult enchantments to obtain [are] efficiency, unbreaking, protection, sharpness, and mending.<ref>{{Cite video}}</ref></blockquote>
Every magic recipe depends on [[Estus Ash]], [[Benzene]] and [[Stabilized Estus]], and the strongest blessings also need a [[Divine Fragment]] or a [[Divine Favor]]. Divine fragments come from breaking [[spawner]]s and defeating powerful mobs, so the pack gives the player a reason to break spawners rather than build mob grinders on them.<ref>{{Cite video|quote=You could make a simple mob grinder, but the divine fragment is staring you in the face. If you want to get to the end, you need that fragment. If you want to make an unbreaking book, Bedrock Busters, Crystal Hearts, or netherite, you need that fragment.}}</ref>

== Crafting enchantments ==
=== Hell-Bound Books ===
{{Main|Hell-Bound Book}}
Every blessing starts from a Hell-Bound Book, the pack's name for the {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. It is crafted from a {{MCW|Book|book}}, a piece of Stabilized Estus and a Benzene, and stacks to 64.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/hell_bound_book.json}}</ref> The path to the first book runs through several magic ingredients:

# Kill undead [[mobs]] for [[Raw Estus]] (which turns into Estus Ash when picked up) or Estus Ash directly.
# Craft [[Benzene]] from a [[Glass Bottle]], three [[Hellspore]] and a [[Sulfur Chunk]].
# Kill an {{MCW|Enderman}} for a [[Stable Void]].
# Craft Stabilized Estus from seven Estus Ash, a Benzene and a Stable Void.
# Craft the Hell-Bound Book from a book, a Stabilized Estus and a Benzene.

=== Blessings ===
{{Main|Blessing}}
A blessing is crafted by surrounding a Hell-Bound Book with themed ingredients. Each of the 23 blessing recipes produces a book with a fixed set of enchantments at fixed levels, named as a prayer or elegy to a deity or mythological figure. The table below lists them all.

{{Data/Blessings}}

=== Ofuda ===
The [[Mouthpiece]] (the pack's librarian) trades an [[Ofuda]], an enchanted book with its own prayer, for five of the [[Sacred texts|sacred texts]], each with one or two [[Crystal Heart]]s. Apart from loot and [[Adamant equipment|adamant equipment]], which is smithed with Protection I, Sharpness I or Efficiency, these are the only source of {{MCW|Protection}} and {{MCW|Sharpness}}. The only other source of Mending besides loot is the [[Prayer of Lu Ban]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/librarian/2/quran.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/adamant_sword.json}}</ref>

{{Data/Ofuda}}

=== Other sources ===
Enchantments can still be found rather than crafted:
* '''Chest loot.''' Many vanilla chest loot tables still contain books with random enchantments, which become Hell-Bound Books. These come from dungeons, mineshafts, desert and jungle pyramids, strongholds, woodland mansions, large ocean ruins and ancient cities, and fishing treasure. Ancient cities also contain {{MCW|Swift Sneak}} books, and bastions and {{MCW|Bartering|piglin bartering}} give {{MCW|Soul Speed}} books. Trial chamber reward vaults contain books with one of Sharpness, Bane of Arthropods, Efficiency, Fortune, Silk Touch, Feather Falling, Riptide, Loyalty, Channeling, Impaling or Mending.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/trial_chambers/reward_rare.json}}</ref> Random books cannot roll the pack's own enchantments, and Fortune cannot roll above level I.
* '''Enchanted equipment.''' Some equipment comes with enchantments: [[Sturdy Leather Boots]] are crafted with Projectile Protection II, Feather Falling II and Trailblaze I, the [[Cleaver]] sold by the [[Cook]] has [[Slaughter]] and Looting II, the [[Hatchet]] sold by the [[Lumberjack]] has [[Bloodrage]], the [[Hepatizon Sword]] is smithed with [[Riposte]] II, and iron swords in [[Abbey]] chests carry [[Anemos]].
* '''Ominous vaults.''' Ominous trial chamber vaults roll a book from the <code>#minecraft:in_enchanting_table</code> tag, which the pack reduces to curses only, so these books always hold {{MCW|Curse of Binding}} or {{MCW|Curse of Vanishing}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/enchantment/in_enchanting_table.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/trial_chambers/reward_ominous_rare.json}}</ref>

== Applying enchantments ==
{{Main|Anvil}}
Blessings are applied like any enchanted book: combine the item and the book in an anvil. The pack lowers the anvil cost multiplier of every vanilla enchantment to 1, the lowest value, so combining books costs few levels.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/enchantment/mending.json}}</ref> The pack's own enchantments have an anvil cost of 0, except [[Frost Protection]] and [[Riposte]] (2).

In 1.12.2, the blessings for [[Anemos]], Frost Protection, [[Reach]], [[Trailblaze]] and [[Zephyr]] store those enchantments under their old <code>main:</code> ids, shown in the tooltip as "ERROR: Please wear me to update" ("ERROR: Please hold me to update" for Anemos). They turn into the real enchantments once the item is worn or held; see [[Blessing#Old enchantment ids]].

=== Experience ===
The player cannot keep {{MCW|Experience|experience}}. Every tick, the pack sets the experience level and points of each player to 0.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/anvil_xp/remove_xp.mcfunction}}</ref> After a player opens an anvil, the next change to their inventory gives them 100 levels and exempts them from the reset until a shared 31-second timer runs out, so anvil work never lacks levels.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/anvil_xp/set_xp.mcfunction}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/anvil_xp/check_anvil_interaction.mcfunction}}</ref> The timer restarts whenever any player's inventory changes, and the check that ends the exemption applies to all players at once.

=== Repair cost ===
Whenever the player's inventory changes, every item in the main inventory and hotbar has its prior-work penalty ({{MCW|Anvil mechanics#Prior work penalty|repair cost}}) reset to 0, so the penalty never builds up with repeated anvil use.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/endless_repairs/function/reset_breakable_repair_cost.mcfunction}}</ref> This part of the pack is based on MiziraGamez's "Repair Cost Remover" data pack.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/endless_repairs/README.txt}}</ref>

=== Exclusivity ===
Besides the vanilla rules, the pack adds some incompatibilities:
* Silk Touch, Fortune and the [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] tool intrinsic are mutually exclusive.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/enchantment/exclusive_set/mining.json}}</ref> The [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] tool intrinsic is exclusive with Silk Touch.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/enchantment/exclusive_set/intrinsic_mining.json}}</ref>
* [[Slaughter]] is exclusive with the vanilla damage enchantments (Sharpness, Smite, Bane of Arthropods, Impaling, Density and Breach).
* The [[magic protection]] intrinsics of shakudo armor and the shakudo elytra use the vanilla armor exclusive set, so they are exclusive with Protection, Blast Protection, Fire Protection and Projectile Protection.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/magic_protection.json}}</ref>
* The [[intrinsic]] enchantments of alloy equipment are exclusive with the other intrinsics for the same kind of item: the armor intrinsics (adamant, electrum, shakudo and the shakudo elytra) with each other, and the weapon intrinsics (adamant, shakudo and the four [[Warding]] levels) with each other.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/enchantment/exclusive_set/intrinsic_armor.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/enchantment/exclusive_set/intrinsic_weapon.json}}</ref>

== Enchanting table ==
The enchanting table's crafting recipe is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref> The pack also replaces the <code>#minecraft:in_enchanting_table</code> tag with curses only, so a table obtained in other ways can only offer Curse of Binding or Curse of Vanishing.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/enchantment/in_enchanting_table.json}}</ref> Breaking an enchanting table drops 2 [[diamond]]s, 4 {{MCW|obsidian}} and a Hell-Bound Book with no enchantments.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/enchanting_table.json}}</ref>

== Removing enchantments ==
The [[grindstone]] works as in vanilla, removing all non-curse enchantments. Because experience is reset every tick, the experience it gives back is lost.
